text_block_list.text: One evening. Passing riverbank heading home after shopping――
Sharp, loud shout rang out. Stopped in surprise, reflexively glanced toward sound――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: If I'm not mistaken, she's…… Yaeno Muteki……？

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
――Fuu! ……Haaa! 
……Seii! ……Taaa!
In evening air, fierce spirit pierced atmosphere. Every fist strike, kick, slash shook ground――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …………Fuuu.
Captivated before realizing. Epitome of ferocity and serenity. Movements refined through relentless discipline……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ――Pardon me. You there.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Collar badge marks you as academy trainer. 
Have business with me?
choice_data_list: Not really…… sorry, I was just fascinated……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That is…… no, one as inexperienced 
as I undeserving of praise.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Executing 『Kata』 now to clear stray thoughts, 
quell surging emotions for tomorrow's Selection Race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Training still insufficient, but intend to give utmost effort tomorrow. ……Should time allow, presence would be honor.
Demeanor echoed ancient martial artist, unconsciously prompting rigid, respectful stance in return.
Suddenly, intruders appeared――！！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text: Oi oi oi oi！ Trouble here, Tracen Academy missy！ This spot is our 『Turf』, get it～！？

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text: Wanna cross, gotta cough up 『Toll』～！！
Belligerent Uma Musume blocked path……！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
……Your 『Turf』? If memory serves, 
area is designated public riverside park, no？

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
Shut mouth～～～！ Don't lecture me！！ 
Aneki, this punk gettin' cheeky！！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Uma Musume B
text_block_list.text:
……Brave. How long will that spirit hold? 
Avoid pain, do as told―― running-crazed girl.
Leader radiated hostile aura！ Cannot stand idle now――！！
choice_data_list: You all need to stop this……！
You all need to stop this……！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh！？ 
Who asks you？ Don't boss me around――！
Yaeno Muteki's sharp shout paralyzed delinquents like lightning strike……！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now then. ……――Wish to continue？
Air froze into absolute stillness―― deep power lurked behind words. Then……

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Uma Musume B
text_block_list.text: ……Fall back. Outmatched.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
Eh, Aneki！？ 
W-wait up～～～！！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
……Necessary to disperse them, 
yet apologize for abrupt yell. Startled you, surely.
choice_data_list: No, I'm grateful for your help

text_block_list.text: Possessed ferocity to freeze delinquents, yet stood calm without wavering――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Much obliged.
What kind of running would race reveal？ Parted ways with high expectations.
Next day. Anticipation in heart, headed to observe Yaeno Muteki's Selection Race――

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Super Creek's run earlier, magnificent……！？ Formidable presence already.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap too…… "Monster" title fits. Rough edges remain, potential undeniable.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: High-caliber prospects abound…… generation full of future champions.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
……Must deliver results this time. 
Prove training with proud victory, without fail……！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa……

text_block_list.name: Participating Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text:
…… 
……Now, right here―― Haaaaaaa！！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ！！ ……Will not…… permit it……！！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ――OooooooooOOOOOo！！

text_block_list.name: Participating Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text: Fufuu, took bait……！

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki…… baited. Emotions too readable. Legs won't endure to finish.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, 『Again』…… Scouted her, but without fixing habit, prospects dim……
Strange sight. Yesterday displayed fierce spirit and tranquil discipline, yet today Yaeno Muteki――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Break through…… like this……！！ 
Haaaaaaaaa！！

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Haa, haa……!!
Driven wild by fierce emotions boiling from within, she was swept up in the run and met with bitter defeat……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa……!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Kuh…… Once again, I…… once again……!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Immature! Far too green…… I am lacking!! To tame this 『Ardent Flame』 within me, I must forge myself further……!
Her face was heavy with bitter remorse…… I could find no words to stop Yaeno Muteki as she walked away.
